harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The preposition phrase «إلى قومه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرسلنا»; «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it explains the sending; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يأتيهم» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «قال» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نذير».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «أن» is explicative (tafsīriyya), and the clause after it is explanatory; «أطيعون» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the nūn; the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the implied (muqaddar) yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The clause «يغفر» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition; the conditional clause «إذا جاء» is parenthetical, and its apodosis is omitted, the khabar (predicate) of «إن» indicating it; the clause «لو كنتم تعلمون» is resumptive, and the apodosis is omitted, i.e.: you would have hastened to what He commanded you.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «ليلا» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «دعوت».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «فلم يَزِدْهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ}; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr), and «فرارًا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «كل» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعلوا»; «ما» is maṣdariyya and temporal, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «جعلوا» is the khabar (predicate) of «إني»; it is permissible for the khabar clause to lack a pronoun referring back to the speaker because it is linked to the clause «دعوتهم» by something resembling a condition, and the referring pronoun is explicit in it; the clause «دعوتهم» is the ṣila of the relative particle (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī); the preposition phrase «في آذانهم» is attached to the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «جِهَارًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), being its kind.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «فقلت» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أسررت», and the clause «إنه كان» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «يرسل» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition; «مدرارا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «السماء», and it is not made feminine because it is on the pattern mifʿāl.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: «ما لكم»: [«ما»] is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, the khabar (predicate); the clause «لا ترجون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the preposition phrase «لله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from «وقارا».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «وقد خلقكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of {تَرْجُونَ}; «أطوارا» is a ḥāl from the kāf.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «كيف» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «خلق» is the object of the verb of seeing, suspended by the interrogative; «طباقًا» is a ḥāl from «سبع سماوات».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The preposition phrase «فيهن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: «نباتًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the maṣdar (verbal noun) being إنباتا.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The preposition phrase «منها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تسلكوا»; «فجاجًا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «سبلا».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «خسارًا» is the second object of «زاد», and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr).

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «ومكروا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila (relative clause) of {مَنْ}; the pronoun is plural only by construing according to the meaning after construing according to the wording in {لَمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ}; «كُبَّارًا» is a naʿt (adjective) of intensification.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: (لا تذرن) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] «لا» is prohibitive; the verb is an imperfect, jussive (majzūm) by the omission of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw of the plural, omitted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «وقد أضلُّوا» is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied (muqaddar) saying, i.e.: Nūḥ said; this implied saying is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {قَالَ نُوحٌ رَبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي}; «كثيرًا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «ولا تزد» is conjoined to «أضلوا»; «ضلالا» is a second object.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The preposition phrase «ممَّا» is composed of the preposition «مِنْ» and the redundant «ما», and the preposition phrase is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أغرقوا»; the preposition phrase «لهم» is attached to «يجدوا»; the preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أنصارًا».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The preposition phrase «من الكافرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ديَّارا».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The conditional clause and its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) are the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; «كفارًا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «فاجرًا».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «مؤمنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «دخل»; «تبارًا» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr).
